value.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood consuming outlandish fiction in all its forms, dreaming of exploring forgotten ruins and finding treasures of every variety. Though [PAWN_pronoun] settled more into the mundanity of [PAWN_possessive] life as time passed, [PAWN_pronoun] never lost that spark of hope for something more exciting.

[PAWN_nameDef] was born heavily deformed. [PAWN_pronoun] was sold to a circus and travelled the wasteland. There, people paid to watch [PAWN_objective] perform various shows. One day, as the company was travelling to a nearby settlement, [PAWN_nameDef] managed to escape.

[PAWN_nameDef] has an inherent disdain for being told what [PAWN_pronoun] can and cannot do, and when [PAWN_pronoun] was a child [PAWN_pronoun] was told that [PAWN_pronoun] couldn't just adopt a random rad rabbit. With almost righteous indignation, [PAWN_pronoun] took care of [PAWN_possessive] pet rad rabbit better than [PAWN_possessive] own well-being.

[PAWN_nameDef] was kidnapped by scavengers at a young age. [PAWN_possessive] small size allowed [PAWN_objective] to fit into tiny maintenance spaces on pre-war ruins to steal valuable electronic components. Coincidentally, [PAWN_pronoun] also became quite adept at treating electrical burns.

[PAWN_nameDef] was born right before the bombs fell. [PAWN_pronoun] was put in cryosleep and survived the destruction. After centuries of deep sleep, [PAWN_pronoun] was found by a wasteland community. [PAWN_nameDef] tries to keep up-beat about life due to sheer luck that was in play for [PAWN_possessive] survival.

[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a simulated environment composed of augmented reality and virtual reality elements inside a robot-tended, automated vault. While safe and idyllic, this placid lifestyle left [PAWN_objective] wanting something more in life.

[PAWN_nameDef] claims that [PAWN_possessive] mind has been visited by an omnipotent entity that manifests itself through advanced pre-war tech objects. While [PAWN_nameDef] shows great affinity towards technology and research, [PAWN_pronoun] harbors equally strong disgust when it comes to plants and animals.

[PAWN_nameDef] was a surgeon at a prestigious clinic until [PAWN_possessive] tendency to take 'culinary liberties' with the deceased was revealed. Rather than damage [PAWN_possessive] reputation by going public, [PAWN_pronoun] was offered a one way trip to the wasteland as a 'retirement package'.

[PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for managing the brahmin cargo of a trade caravan, ensuring supplies were securely stowed and inventory was accurately tracked. [PAWN_pronoun] was physically strong and highly organized, but [PAWN_pronoun] had little patience for detailed documentation or scholarly pursuits.

[PAWN_nameDef]'s sworn enemies left [PAWN_objective] to die in a hostile desert. Despite all the odds, [PAWN_pronoun] survived in such an environment and adapted to it. Due to spending a lot of time living in the wastelands, [PAWN_nameDef] has no knowledge about plants.

[PAWN_nameDef]'s love for machinery and engineering is downright fanatic. In [PAWN_possessive] home town, [PAWN_pronoun] made illegal robots, guns and machines, often being chased by the police. [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't see nature as anything other than a source of materials to be refined into something useful.

[PAWN_nameDef] served as the medic on a caravan, treating everything from heatstroke to injuries from wildlife attacks. [PAWN_possessive] knowledge of medicine was unparalleled, but [PAWN_pronoun] had no head for research or complex theories.

[PAWN_nameDef] is fervently against mutants. [PAWN_pronoun] believes that pure humans have superior minds and spirits in comparison. Though prejudiced, [PAWN_possessive] arguments were well-rehearsed and spoken with authority.

[PAWN_nameDef] spent a lot of [PAWN_possessive] time working on a rodent farm in an urban settlement out in the wasteland. Due to limited spacing and mostly scavenged pre-war foods, [PAWN_pronoun] found great success in offering actual meat for those who wanted a break from mediocrity. Granted, [PAWN_pronoun] ended up on the run because [PAWN_possessive] Ratburgers attracted the taxman, but [PAWN_pronoun] found it fun while it lasted.

[PAWN_nameDef] was the Chef in a pirate base. Between meals, [PAWN_pronoun] told tall tales that kept the gang's morale high. The gang's loyalty to their chef was great, possibly even greater than to their chief...

[PAWN_nameDef] was essential in managing the settlement's logistics and supply chains, ensuring the efficient flow of goods and materials. Highly organized but not particularly hands-on, [PAWN_pronoun] steered clear of direct care roles and skilled manual work.

[PAWN_nameDef] wasn't always part of the tribes. After getting exiled from [PAWN_possessive] local wastelander settlement due to ruining an entire crop harvest, [PAWN_nameDef] had to live out in the open for years, with only crude tools to aid [PAWN_objective]. This made [PAWN_objective] a jack-of-all-trades, but completely broke [PAWN_possessive] trust of people.

[PAWN_nameDef] oversaw a large hydroponic garden, specializing in the cultivation of rare plants and feeding the people. [PAWN_possessive] green thumb was unparalleled, yet [PAWN_pronoun] lacked the physical capabilities for demanding labor or combat.

[PAWN_nameDef] was once in a major criminal organization, but after being caught, [PAWN_pronoun] became an informant for the Enclave Intelligence. As part of the deal, [PAWN_pronoun] would be given a new name and identity and be shipped off to a wasteland settlement.
